journey.label: CAREER JOURNEY
journey.heading: From the front line to leadership.
journey.intro: My career began with solving technical problems for users and grew into leading companies and teams. Each step broadened how I think about business problems.

entries.title: Starting in IT support
entries.text: I began as a technician diagnosing and repairing computers and printers. It taught me to listen to users and find the root cause of a problem.

entries.title: Building digital products
entries.text: I moved into data analysis and digital product development, learning how teams take a user need and turn it into something people can use.

entries.title: Founding Sliva Technology Indonesia
entries.organization: Founder & CEO · PT Sliva Technology Indonesia
entries.text: Founding Sliva shifted my responsibilities from building products to setting the direction of a company. That year, Universitas Muhammadiyah Riau also recorded my national first-place award at Forum Digital BUMN.

entries.title: Developing SlivaDoc and speaking publicly
entries.text: I became CEO of SlivaDoc, with a focus on digitizing animal health services. At WebDevTalk, I spoke about Web3 and the future of the internet.

entries.title: Leading technology across industries
entries.organization: Indo Teknik · MSIG Life · GMS Church · Lion Parcel
entries.text: As Head of Technology at Indo Teknik, I worked on project planning, team coordination, and product development. My work at MSIG Life, GMS Church, and Lion Parcel broadened my experience in insurance, community organizations, and logistics.

entries.title: Taking on new executive roles
entries.organization: ZÉRA · Aracita Group · PT Yuk Inovasi Digital
entries.text: I took on CEO roles at ZÉRA and Aracita Group and the CTO role at PT Yuk Inovasi Digital while continuing to lead Sliva and SlivaDoc.

ventures.label: VENTURES & LEADERSHIP
ventures.heading: The companies and teams I lead.
ventures.intro: My work spans company building, product development, and aligning technology decisions with business needs.

entries.name: Sliva Technology Indonesia
entries.text: I founded PT Sliva Technology Indonesia to develop digital solutions around business needs. As CEO, I lead the company’s direction and product development.

entries.name: SlivaDoc
entries.text: SlivaDoc helps veterinary clinics and pet shops digitize their operations, from animal health records to day-to-day service workflows.

entries.name: Aracita Group
entries.text: Aracita plans, coordinates, and produces events, from corporate programs and brand activations to weddings.

entries.name: ZÉRA
entries.text: I serve as CEO of ZÉRA, one of the business leadership roles I took on in 2026.

entries.name: PT Yuk Inovasi Digital
entries.text: As CTO, I focus on the company’s technology direction and how it serves business needs.

work.name: Lion Parcel
